random.seed(567);np.random.seed(567)
t0=time.time();times=[]
for i in range(12000):

    if i%4==0:c[:]=random.choice([1,2,100,1000])
    paths=[];d=[];n=0

            common=random.sample(range(E),random.randint(1,min(E,10)))

            paths.append([random.sample(range(E),random.randint(1,min(E,12))) for _ in range(count)])
        d.append(random.choice([0,1,2,3,10,100,1000]))
    mode=random.choice(['admit','route']);rho=random.randint(1,8)

    bias=np.random.uniform(*bounds,E)

        result=propose(list(range(K)),c,d,paths,mode,rho,bias)
        verify(list(range(K)),c,d,paths,mode,rho,bias,result)

    dt=time.time()-t;times.append(dt)
